Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for all activity rows in assay CHEMBL1613996. Filter to exact measurements where standard_relation is '=' and standard_value is not null. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles, and join activities to assays to filter by the specified assay. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort the results by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
